offers.headline: Can I park here?
offers.text: Pick a time and how long you are staying, and ParkingMinder maps where you can park in parts of London, from council and TfL open data. Always check the signs.

offers.headline: When is your child off school?
offers.text: TermMinder finds school holidays, term dates and the next day back, taken from the authority that sets them, with the source on every page.

offers.headline: Never miss bin day
offers.text: BinMinder looks up your bin collection dates with most UK councils and sends a free email reminder before each bin day.

offers.headline: How far do school places reach?
offers.text: Schools in Reach shows how far places reached at schools near your postcode in past years, and estimates your chances. Free, with no sign-up.

offers.headline: School term dates as an API
offers.text: TermMinder's Data API serves school term dates and holidays with their sources, for booking, childcare and family software.
